findings.finding: The resolver computes the latest expected completed UTC-anchored two-hour slot and permits equality at the local first-valid boundary.
The exact expected slot is resolved before completeness filtering and missing or invalid expected slots clear dependent links without older-parent carry-forward.
Instrument, side, release, calendar, lattice, source and first-valid chronology mismatches fail closed.
Fixed observation, measurement, structural-by-depth, axis, higher-order local-clock and episode projections remain separate typed products.
Parent objects are linked by authoritative identity and definition hash and are not recreated as local parent ranges.
Role projections expose complete candidate inventories, eligibility, exclusions, nullable selection and permanently null fallback fields.
Zero eligible objects and unresolved multiplicity return explicit null without hidden latest, nearest, widest, smallest, best or fallback selection.
Context refresh is represented as lifecycle evidence and not as a local market transition.
Age remains multidimensional raw evidence and no universal freshness or staleness threshold is implemented.
Computability remains component-scoped with no global degraded collapse.
Episode candidates remain separately visible and unavailable without independent C2E or C2.5 authority.
All outputs remain inactive, noncanonical and SHADOW_FROZEN_READ_ONLY with active C2 and downstream authority unchanged.

corrective_history.finding: The initial .json registry filename was detected by the frozen programme census as a new formal programme object.
corrective_history.resolution: Renamed the non-programme resolver registry to .jsonc and updated its bounded test reference without weakening the census or changing resolver semantics.

recommendation_rationale: All CEAR-G8 acceptance conditions are implemented deterministically inside the approved inactive, noncanonical shadow envelope. The only encountered defect was a repository-census filename side effect, which was corrected without altering the frozen census or resolver policy.
rollback: Disable shadow consumers and rebuild outputs from immutable inputs. Preserve the CEAR-G8 decision, identities, chronology, no-fallback rule and typed-context separation.
